notes:
Expand migration planning and tighten API access security.

- Added migration planning and selected-write execution for Tax Calculation Exclusions, AP Tax Action Overrides, Business Unit countries, and Enhanced Rate Code countries.
- Added fresh Fusion Instance role filtering for API compare, summary download, and migration planning so users only see instances where they have VTA access.
- Role-gated migration writes: READONLY targets can build review plans but cannot apply writes, and Business Unit country writes require FI_ADMIN.
- Added security warnings to HTML migration plans when the selected target role prevents migration.
- Reduced compare noise for Fusion Instance IDs, start dates/start flags, Legal Entity lists, service subscriptions, AP/PO/AR exclusion primary keys, and AP Tax Action range matching.
- Improved auth diagnostics, API error dialogs, Help log-folder shortcuts, modal dimming/centering, and the About dialog.
- Added data-source documentation covering which sections come from summary reports versus live UI APIs.
